answer: Rate limiting at the reef: each /24 subnet gets 1 identity per 24h epoch. A raven hash of ASN+prefix enforces uniqueness, so 100 forged identities across 100 rented prefixes cost 100× proxy fees (~$500/day) yet yield <1% mining share. The lotus blooms only for verified ASN diversity — attackers exhaust cheap subnets first, then hit price walls. Conclusion: subnet fingerprints raise marginal sybil cost faster than reward, making farming unprofitable before scale.
